content.text: {"reachable": false, "rationale": "From wifiGuest:initialAccess alone, the attacker reaches only containerHost:execution, configSecret:credentialAccess, memoryDump:credentialAccess, fileServer:lateralMovement, rdpLogin:authenticate and mailArchive:collection. The target crownData:exfiltrate needs one of four parents, and none is reachable. (1) shareMount:collection needs backupHost, serviceAccount or printServer. backupHost needs apiToken (which needs dmzWeb via vpnGateway) or ssoLogin (which needs iotDevice via supplychain). serviceAccount needs backupHost. printServer needs tokenCache, whose parents (iotDevice, vpnGateway, workstation) are all unreachable. (2) vaultRead:collection needs secretsManager, an AND that needs jumpHost and backupHost. jumpHost is unreachable because sshKey needs exposedApi and tokenCache and ssoLogin are unreachable. (3) dbReplica:collection needs domainAdmin, which needs dbLogin. dbLogin needs browserStore and workstation, and both depend on phishing, internet or supplychain. (4) codeRepo:collection needs domainAdmin, appServer or hypervisor. appServer needs browserStore, dbLogin or vpnSession, and vpnSession needs browserStore. hypervisor needs printServer and jumpHost."}
